steps.speaker: Yokna
steps.content: We've lost contact with the Lumanaris rep. Wandering deeper now is suicide.

steps.speaker: Jabara
steps.content: Look over there, an opening in the Mania! We can make a run for it.

steps.speaker: Rael
steps.content: Let go of me, Jab! I said let go!

steps.speaker: Jabara
steps.content: Forget your pride for now! Staying alive comes first. We'll sort the rest once we're out. You have my word.
[Scene Change]
From a distance, Hypatia watches the leaders slip through the opening she tore in the Mania. A slow breath of relief escapes her.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Not just Aurum Secretum assassins... but Underground Puppets, too. Has the collaboration between the Underground and Fraser grown this intimate?
But something is definitely off here. The contamination in Furor is far thinner than it should be at a Black Ring's epicenter; otherwise, tearing that opening would not have been nearly as easy.
She pulls out the map, finds the intersection where she and Rust parted, and resolves to regroup with him.
But after checking every branching path and shadowed corner, the truth is undeniable: all viable routes are sealed by contaminated cave-ins.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: This is...?!

Meanwhile, Saina stops short within the Mania field. The deeper she tracks, the more foreign objects she finds beneath her feet. It's clear now that someone has been laying groundwork here, preparing deliberately...
Deep Within the Ruins

At the other end of the ruins' uncharted depths, a cramped space—less than twenty square meters—has been freshly cleared. Aurum Secretum devices pulse along a roughly circular perimeter, pushing the thick contamination back to expose the ground beneath.

There, a web of cracks spreads, all converging inward toward a narrow, perfectly drilled abyss, just wide enough for a person. Banished beyond the barrier, unseen entities press against the Aurum Secretum field, rustling with a palpable anxiety at their separation.

Inside the circle, Daik of the Luminaris Society kneels at the pit's edge, carefully retrieving fragments. He strives for devout focus, but something in the agitated white noise beyond the perimeter snags his attention.

steps.speaker: Daik
steps.content: Who's there?

A point of red light pierces the darkness. A figure in black steps across the perimeter. The air crackles as Aurum Secretum and sorcery bite into his skin, peeling it back from his face, but he doesn't slow. By the time he fully enters the circle, the damage has already sealed itself over. Rust rolls his shoulders, offering Daik a casual, unnerving smile.

steps.speaker: Yin Yansheng
steps.content: I'm glad I've found the right man.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Hello, Representative. Weren't you meant to be leading the leaders on a grand tour? Did you get separated from the group?

steps.speaker: Daik
steps.content: Your lodgings lost communication last night. That's when I thought today might afford a chance for a... private meeting. I'm pleased I haven't been waiting for the wrong person, either.

Daik gathers the abyss fragment, its sinister glow pulsing in his grasp, and places it into an intricate Aurum Secretum vessel. After sealing it, he cradles the container in his palms and recites several phrases with devotional reverence. He then transfers it to a precisely crafted sorcery box, securing it within three successive layers before finally, cautiously, closing the lid.
Only then does he turn, lifting his gaze to assess the lone, uninvited guest standing before him.

steps.speaker: Daik
steps.content: So you're the spy who's been giving the Society such a headache. To see you in the flesh at last... Conventional wisdom had you targeting some high-profile dignitary. What prompted the sudden departure from Fraser to come here?

steps.speaker: Daik
steps.content: And that dead weight from the Campbell line? How did you shake her off? You killed her?

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Miss Campbell is the only person in the Luminaris Society who truly merits the title of scholar. A mind of that caliber shouldn't be brought here to have her eyes sullied.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: ...Especially by filth like this.

He raises his hand and fires three rapid shots. Enhanced by the ruin's contamination, the flesh-made bullets strike the three Aurum Secretum devices suspended overhead, shattering them alongside the one-eyed Underground rune sealed within.

The ground shudders. The Mania field twists violently, collapsing Daik's painstakingly simulated matrix. The surface rift snaps shut, and with it, the inheritance remnants he had fought to reclaim vanish.

steps.speaker: Daik
steps.content: A pity. That sorcery was painstakingly replicated. Data calibrated through countless iterations. We had only just begun to replicate some characteristics of a Black Ring. A remarkable feat... you shouldn't have destroyed it so carelessly...

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Truly remarkable work doesn't need to hide in the shadows. You know as well as I do that yours cannot bear the light of day.

steps.speaker: Daik
steps.content: Heh. Aren't you just the same?
Daik narrows his eyes, studying the specimen before him with meticulous attention.

The agent's coat is made of an unusual material—both protective and restrictive, like a binding seal—pulled taut against his form, emphasizing his corpselike pallor. The injuries from crossing the barrier have vanished, yet on his neck, several uncanny dark markings linger faintly.
Around him, contamination slowly gathers. The marks on his neck begin to writhe like something alive, and from their depths, a faint red glow seeps through.
Daik can't help but smile at the sight.

steps.speaker: Daik
steps.content: The Sophos of the Underground once spoke of this art: using a Black Ring's power to reshape life. The blessed ones chase the Ring and flee from it, yet their very existence remains tethered to it.

steps.speaker: Daik
steps.content: How long has it been since you left your "mother"? Even breathing must be a labor for you now, mustn't it?
Rust doesn't answer. Instead, he closes his eyes, draws a shallow breath as if savoring the air, and then smiles to the watching researcher.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: It is a burden, I won't deny it. But it's more than enough to handle the likes of you.
The crimson glow snakes down his neck and across his skin, igniting all the way to his fingertips.

Rust's eyes blaze red as energy surges from the fissures in his neck, flooding his entire being. He raises his gun and fires. Daik ducks with a sharp cry, shielding the collection box he just secured.

Simultaneously, the box itself shudders violently. An Aurum Secretum field erupts from it, bending the dense Mania field around it to warp the bullet's path. The shot veers into the darkness—a dull impact, then distorted shrieks. Guided by the Aurum Secretum, dozens of corrupted tentacles pierce the barrier, lashing toward Rust.
He doesn't flinch. Tossing his gun aside to tangle several limbs, he charges straight into the assault.

The tentacles slice through his coat, cut into flesh and vessels, then immediately convulse and crackle as if electrocuted. From Rust's wounds flows an alien fluid, neither blood nor ichor, melting the corruption like magma. The rampaging entities shriek and recoil from this human-shaped abomination.

Unimpeded, Rust closes on Daik, crushes the Aurum Secretum box underfoot, and seizes him by the throat, lifting him clear off the ground. Daik chokes violently, yet his voice travels directly into Rust's mind through the bones of the hand gripping him.
—The mad scholar is thrilled beyond measure at this close encounter with an experimental subject.

steps.speaker: Daik
steps.content: ...This vessel, just as they described. Even a form lesser than the Sages possesses such formidable power... What extraordinary heights have the Sophos' arts reached?

steps.speaker: Daik
steps.content: How did it feel... to receive a Black Ring's baptism? How resilient is the life it reconstructs? You've died once... no, at least three times, haven't you? What was it like? What changes did it forge?

steps.speaker: Daik
steps.content: ...If I were to unmake you completely now, could I observe the entire process of rebirth? How would your new form manifest? Would there be variations?
Rust finds the researcher's obsessive thirst for knowledge almost amusing.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Adelaide lacks the patience to explain these things to outsiders. Are there other Undergrounders lecturing in Fraser? Where? What have they been teaching?

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: ...Are you trying to create another Black Ring?

steps.speaker: Daik
steps.content: Aren't you anticipating it? Everything you are... is clearly a Black Ring's gift. You should be its most grateful apostle...

steps.speaker: Daik
steps.content: Argh!!
Rust slams him violently against his precious Aurum Secretum box, cutting his rant short. Daik looks up, and sees only cold hatred and contempt staring back.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Not everything. Take this, for example: your most coveted "Underground sorcery." I learned it on my own.
Blind rage surges as Rust grabs him, hand rising for another blow when suddenly—
Whoosh!!

With the Aurum Secretum box at its center, a sorcery of eight layers rises from the ground, forming a circle roughly six feet wide. The sudden resonance makes Rust freeze for a split second. In that instant, a wave of thick, black contamination surges from the side, tears Daik and the fractured box from his grasp, and rolls to a stop at the edge of the circle.

The sludge writhes as it deposits both man and box. After several fluid shifts, it reshapes itself into a hunched figure cloaked in black—an elderly form, robed and still. Beneath the grateful, reverent gaze of the Luminaris representative, the figure slowly rises.
They stare at one another in silence, each seeing something in the other's face that is at once deeply familiar and utterly alien.
The quiet holds until a slow drip of melting contamination falls from the ceiling. Only then does Rust bow his head and laugh.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: ...Heh. I thought I'd have to tear Fraser apart brick by brick to find your kind. Never expected you to just... deliver yourselves to me.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Do you really despise me that much?
He speaks at last, in a tongue Daik cannot fathom, but to Rust, every syllable is clear.

steps.speaker: Undergrounder
steps.content: ...We gave you chances. More than one. To return to us.

steps.speaker: Undergrounder
steps.content: Yet all we received... was betrayal. Time and again...

steps.speaker: Undergrounder
steps.content: So. Enough...
Sorcery draws the contamination into his palm as the Undergrounder prepares to strike. His voice, when he speaks, is heavy with sorrow.

steps.speaker: Undergrounder
steps.content: No one remains to speak for you. Those who still held any care for you are dead. You have failed every soul who ever placed faith in you.

steps.speaker: Undergrounder
steps.content: They will curse you for eternity. Never forgive. I have been tasked to kill you as many times as it takes. And when I am gone, others will come to scour you from existence...

steps.speaker: Undergrounder
steps.content: Traitor. Deserter. The one who abandoned the Black Ring and survived by walking over the corpses of his own... Remember my words. Remember who ends you... Remember...

steps.speaker: Undergrounder
steps.content: You are beyond redemption.
Rust listens quietly until the end, then lowers his head.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: I see... What a pity.
Then he raises his head again, that familiar smile returning to his face.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: After I died last time, it seems I forgot all of you again.
The words ignite the Undergrounder's rage. He launches into an incantation, and the recently recovered box against his chest begins to shudder violently.

Inside, fragments of the inheritance vessel still pulse with latent power. That resentful energy now awakens, magnifying the single-eyed sorcery until it multiplies across the chamber. From beyond, countless malevolent presences start to converge. The time for games is over. Rust tenses, every muscle coiling for the fight.

steps.speaker: Undergrounder
steps.content: You exist because of the Black Ring. The Black Ring gave you bone and blood, time and time again...

steps.speaker: Undergrounder
steps.content: Give it back, betrayer! No matter how many times you die, you must return it! You cannot escape...!
...Escape? The notion is so absurd that it nearly draws a genuine laugh from Rust.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: ...I don't escape. I've been waiting all along.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: The Black Ring gave me nothing but a curse. You'd better take every last shred of it back!

He raises his hand and drives his fingers into his own chest, sinking deep into the fissures etched across his body. Bone and blood dissolve and spill over, transforming into chaotic Mania under his will—a torrent he hurls forth, shattering the oncoming sorcery. All the while, a bone-deep fury consumes him.
Does he hate the person before him? No, that grudge is far gone from his memory. What does linger is the sound of their pious words, the memory of what was sacrificed in the name of "faith."
...In the end, regardless of which side they're on, when it comes to stubbornness, they're all the same.
His blood, bone, and flesh are ignited now. Every cell in Rust's body has become a weapon. Just as he prepares to unleash everything—
Whoosh!

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: —What?!

A hair-thin beam of golden light pierces the contamination, striking the Aurum Secretum box in the Undergrounder's arms with exacting precision. A high-frequency vibration shudders through the air, and the half-open lid slams shut as if crushed under immense pressure, sealing all chaotic energy inside. It cannot be reopened.
The Aurum Secretum box has been decrypted and locked; he can no longer complete the extraction. The Undergrounder lifts his head toward the source of the attack, but Rust is already moving.
He withdraws every ounce of power he'd been channeling for the confrontation and rushes toward the sudden intervener, placing himself as a shield between her and the fray.
Behind him stands Hypatia, of course. When she sees Rust approach, she flinches visibly. Her master is so stunned, the reprimand he had ready dies on his lips.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Sigh...

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Didn't we agree to split up? You—

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I've neutralized all the traps! The leaders are safe!
Her answer comes in a rapid burst. But the effect is spoiled when a grain-sized Aurum Secretum bee slips from Rust's pocket and silently flies back to its rightful owner.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I'm sorry. I was concerned it would be too dangerous for you to act alone...
She finally lowers her head, her voice soft with confession.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: ...No apology needed. You performed exceptionally. You've already surpassed your master.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: You're teasing me again...
But Rust isn't joking. The earlier rage has cooled, allowing his mind to clear and reassess.
The enemy's most dangerous weapon has already been neutralized—by his own exceptional apprentice, no less. She turned his strength against him. A lone Undergrounder no longer poses a real threat.
Across the space, the Undergrounder is staring directly at them.

steps.speaker: Undergrounder
steps.content: ...Aurum Secretum control... extraordinarily precise...
His gaze falls on Hypatia, and he chuckles with sudden recognition.

steps.speaker: Undergrounder
steps.content: So it's you... the "limb" the Famine Sage could not bear to sever...

steps.speaker: Undergrounder
steps.content: Truly... a remarkable talent...

Hypatia cannot comprehend his praise. The language is too warped, too guttural, like a nauseating, moan-like distortion. Beneath the cloak, his shadowed face feels impossible to look upon directly, stirring a deep, instinctive dread.
Can the figure before them even be called human? At his feet, the black sludge left by the Black Ring gathers and kneels, worshipping him—worshipping whatever he holds.
And when she sealed the Aurum Secretum box, Hypatia felt it: an evil once buried beneath Furor, still pulsing with the aura of the inheritance. It made her tremble even more.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Are we going to fight... that?

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Wait! Your body—
Despite the dim light, Hypatia clearly sees the fissures etched across Rust's body. Their red glow seems even more ominous in the dark.
Rust shifts back half a step, shielding her from the Undergrounder's sight. As he does, he tugs discreetly at his collar, pulling it up to hide the marks.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Don't look. They're just unsightly blemishes. I'm fine; this is just me... restraining my true strength.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: You saved all the leaders. Our mission is accomplished. We've won. Now, victory means leaving safely. You've passed your final exam; congratulations on graduating. Let's go.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: They know their limits. They don't have what it takes to stop me.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Really...?
Hypatia remains uneasy. Unexpectedly, it is one of their opponents who speaks first, agreeing with Rust's assessment.

Daik clears his throat, his excitement still palpable from witnessing the battle's advanced techniques. However, with Hypatia's intervention and the Aurum Secretum box now sealed, a clear victory for his side is no longer feasible.

steps.speaker: Daik
steps.content: You're correct. Having seen your capabilities firsthand, I recognize we lack the means to detain you both. However... we cannot allow you to dismantle the Society's designs entirely.

steps.speaker: Daik
steps.content: The Unity Gala will proceed as planned, exactly as Fraser intends... We have allies you haven't accounted for.

The device concealed on his body transmits its signals silently. Daik is certain that their plan is still salvageable. Everything is proceeding on schedule, the critical moment drawing near; his only regret is that he won't be there to witness it.
He releases a quiet sigh and turns his gaze to the Undergrounder beside him.

steps.speaker: Daik
steps.content: ...For wisdom. For the city-state.
The ally receives the signal. Meanwhile, someone who knows him well senses that something is wrong.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: You... Damn it!
Rust's hand flies to his holster, but it's empty. His weapons were already torn apart and consumed by the tentacles. It's too late to intervene.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Nngh—!
Something deep within him stirs. From the depths of the fissures, a force clamps down, locking his movements. He looks up. The Undergrounder is casting.

It's a vicious sorcery. The Undergrounder's left hand withers and rots; half his cloak crumples inward as flesh and fabric collapse. The fanatic is sacrificing half his body just to hold Rust, unevenly, for a moment. And meanwhile—

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Ah!

Without warning, the Undergrounder raises his right hand and drives a beam of crimson light straight into Daik. The red Mania sorcery pierces through Daik's satisfied smile, blasting away part of his head in a spray of flesh. It happens too fast. Hypatia doesn't even have time to scream.
How... Weren't they allies? She can't process it, yet in that same heartbeat, she suddenly understands what Rust meant by "brutal battlefield."

Across the space, the fanatic's plan is complete. With only half a body remaining, the Undergrounder trembles violently, clutching the Aurum Secretum box as his ravaged form shakes with low, breathless laughter.

steps.speaker: Undergrounder
steps.content: Remember... traitor who cast off his own name...

steps.speaker: Undergrounder
steps.content: No matter how many times... all the Black Ring gave you... will be reclaimed... cursing you unto death...
He vanishes into the pool of his own purulent blood, merging with the surrounding filth.

Only Daik's grotesquely disfigured corpse remains. Rust hasn't yet broken free from the curse, but he's already noticed something crucial: the enemy used the same flesh sorcery he knows. Then, footsteps approach from nearby.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Hypatia... get out of here. Now... You can't stay...

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: This is... their true purpose. You have to go...

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I don't understand... No, I won't leave you...

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Go...
BOOM!!

Following the narrow path Hypatia used to enter, a violent explosion suddenly blasts open the exit. For a moment, the thick reek of blood and decay is swept aside, and with it come those who will uncover the "truth."
The newcomers' eyes widen in horror at the scene: two blood-drenched figures and, not far off, a corpse.

At their head is an Aurum Secretum Warrior, her face twisted with fury. She too seems to have just broken free from a Mania field, and in her grip is a Puppet fragment stamped with a DisCity mark. She slams it down before them all.

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: ...I knew it... I KNEW IT!!!

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: TRAITORS! MURDERERS! I'LL KILL EVERY LAST ONE OF YOU!
